WITH date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq IN (1222,1222+1,1222+2,1222+3,1222+4,1222+5,1222+6,1222+7,1222+8,1222+9,1222+10,1222+11)
),
item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics')
      AND i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help')
      AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men')
      AND i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
      AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1')
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT item_filtered.i_manager_id, date_filtered.d_moy, SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM item_filtered
    JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item_filtered.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_filtered ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY item_filtered.i_manager_id, date_filtered.d_moy
),
avg_sales AS (
    SELECT monthly_sales.i_manager_id, AVG(monthly_sales.sum_sales) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM monthly_sales
    GROUP BY monthly_sales.i_manager_id
)
SELECT monthly_sales.i_manager_id, monthly_sales.sum_sales, avg_sales.avg_monthly_sales
FROM monthly_sales
JOIN avg_sales ON monthly_sales.i_manager_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM avg_sales.i_manager_id
WHERE CASE WHEN avg_sales.avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN abs(monthly_sales.sum_sales - avg_sales.avg_monthly_sales) / avg_sales.avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY monthly_sales.i_manager_id, avg_sales.avg_monthly_sales, monthly_sales.sum_sales
LIMIT 100
